$schema: lanes allowed to report not-run (visible-skip discipline, e2e ADR-0001)
comment: A lane listed here may report 'not run' without failing the run — but the report is LOUD and names its tracking issue. A lane that BUILDS while listed here fails the run: a stale entry is drift, and removing it is part of the tracking issue. Currently empty: the Rust interop lane was RETIRED from the matrix by E2E-4 (#8) — the Rust client is not an SDK (e2e ADR-0001 'SDK matrix'); clients/rust stays in the tree as the Adversary Client's base, rebuilt by E2E-5 (#9).
